'''Lonus World''', also known as '''Lonus Woud''', was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thaere Privo]] in the [[Thaereian system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Memories" />
